SELECT
  (CASE
     WHEN s."key" IS NOT NULL THEN s."key"
     WHEN sl."key" IS NOT NULL THEN sl."key" || '+' || p."key"
     ELSE NULL
   END) || '+' || st."key" AS composed_key,
  r.db_content AS db_content
FROM cards r
JOIN cards st ON st.id = r.right_id
LEFT JOIN cards s ON s.id = r.left_id
LEFT JOIN cards sl ON sl.id = s.left_id
LEFT JOIN cards p ON p.id = s.right_id
WHERE r.trash = 0
  AND r.right_id = (SELECT id FROM cards
                    WHERE ("key" = '*structure' OR name = '*structure')
                      AND trash = 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)
